- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of evading enemy's attack & damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Guards all attacks
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}

turn*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- High chance of evading enemy's attack
- "Corroded Body and Mind" Category allies' DEF 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
- DEF 20%{passiveImg:up_g} and damage reduction rate 5%{passiveImg:up_g} for allies whose
names include "Baby" or "Possessed"
